title: When Rubrics Do Not Decide: Silent Value Completion in LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-criterion LLM judges often evaluate responses without specifying how conflicting criteria resolve, leaving the winner undetermined even under exact criterion scores. Issuing a strict verdict without declaring the required trade-off premise constitutes silent value completion. We introduce TradeoffBench to isolate this failure by separating rule execution from response scoring. On authoritative criterion vectors, six open-weight non-reasoning judges pass all dominance and equality controls yet pick unsupported winners on 9%-81% of 1,345 conflicts. All 577 order-stable choices follow an explicitly banned majority rule. Reasoning-enabled configurations drop anonymous-vector violations to 2 in 9,720 judgments under an explicit rule, yet cannot bridge omitted trade-offs or divergent component scoring. On raw TradeoffBench text with unspecified trade-offs, GPT-6.1-sol omits its completion premise in 29.8% of 400 verified conflicts. Eve

translated_title: 当评分标准无法决断时：LLM评估中的静默价值补全
translated_abstract: 多准则LLM评判者在评估响应时，通常不会指明相互冲突的准则应如何权衡取舍，导致即使在精确的准则得分下，胜者也依然悬而未决。在未声明所需权衡前提的情况下给出严格判定，即构成了“静默价值补全”。我们提出TradeoffBench基准，通过将规则执行与响应评分相分离来隔离这一失败模式。在权威准则向量上，六个开源权重的非推理型评判者虽然通过了所有支配性与相等性控制测试，却在1,345个冲突中的9%-81%的情形下选出了缺乏依据的胜者。全部577个顺序稳定的选择均遵循了被明确禁止的多数规则。在显式规则下，启用推理的配置将匿名向量违规降至9,720次判断中仅2次，但仍无法弥补被遗漏的权衡或各分量评分的分歧。在权衡未指明的原始TradeoffBench文本上，GPT-6.1-sol在400个已验证冲突中有29.8%的情况下省略了其补全前提。
tldr: 本文提出TradeoffBench基准，揭示多准则LLM评判者在准则冲突时会在未声明权衡前提的情况下静默补全价值判断，导致在9%-81%的冲突中选出缺乏依据的胜者。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TradeoffBench, showing that multi-criterion LLM judges silently complete value judgments—picking unsupported winners in 9%-81% of conflicting-criterion cases—without declaring the required trade-off premise.
